description: CreativBowls — a rolling food trailer serving vibrant acai, pitaya, blue spirulina and coconut bowls loaded with fresh fruit, plus iced/hot coffee, fresh-squeezed lemonade, burrito bowls, tacos, burgers, hotdogs and loaded nachos. Based in Milton, FL and traveling from Pensacola to Panama City Beach — catch the weekly schedule on Facebook, posted every Sunday.
